_domainNote: PLACEHOLDER. RFC 2606 reserved .example TLD, so it can never point at a real third party while the site is in staging. Set domain + origin here AND domainConfirmed to true once the real domain is purchased and DNS is pointed at the host. Every canonical, sitemap URL, og:url and schema @id is derived from origin, so this one value plus the two in data/config.json is the whole swap.

conversion._statusNote: status is pending until the /api/leads handler exists at the edge (Cloudflare Worker, Netlify Function or equivalent). While pending, the request form renders in an honest not-yet-active state and the submit control is disabled, rather than pretending a submission worked. Set status to active once the handler is deployed and tested.
